text:
Jamal K: taking primary for the 17:00-01:00 UTC slot today. swapping from @Alex R. I'll be on-call in eu-west for the first half, then shifting to us-east. shadow? :wave:

Alex R: thanks — confirmed handoff. shadowing will be Maria P for the overlap 20:30-21:30 UTC. i've left notes in the runbook and pinned metrics dashboards.

Maria P: @Jamal K I'll shadow the first hour and watch paging. what are the top things to look for? any active flakes?

Jamal K: main things: 502 spikes on /v1/generate, elevated tail latency on small batch RTs. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff
- quick checks: viz -> /dashboards/latency, /dashboards/errors
- if 502 spike, try rolling back recent routing rule (route: canary->fallback) or increase dedicated pool autoscale temporarily.

Sophia L: paging note — if we see >5% 5xx over 5m on prod models, escalate to pager escalation level 2 and ping SRE channel. use incident-bot tag: `incident-bot create --sev=2 --summary="5xx spike"`

oncall-bot: Automated reminder: primary handoff scheduled at 17:00 UTC. Overlap window: 20:30-21:30 UTC for shadowing. Pager routing set to primary+secondary.

Alex R: couple of runbook snippets I added:
```
# handoff checklist
- confirm tokens & keys present in vault
- export metrics snapshot: /scripts/export_metrics.sh --since=10m
- check model pool health: curl -s http://infra-api/pools | jq '.[] | select(.status=="degraded")'
```

Maria P: noted. I'll run the metrics export at 20:25 UTC and post snapshots here.

Jamal K: FYI there is an ongoing low-volume customer-facing glitch from earlier today — tickets flaring but degraded to low-priority after patch. No active pages expected but keep an eye on `customer-impact` logs for related traces.

Sophia L: tagging @oncall-bot for the customer-impact alerters to ensure we get traces: `incident-bot attach-trace --alert-id=ci-3241` once paged.

Maria P: snapshot posted: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/1777777880 - looks like 502s on model-cpu-node-3, increased retry count. I'm going to warm a spare node and watch.

Alex R: :thumbsup: if warming works, schedule for draining node-3 later tonight in 01:30 UTC maintenance window. otherwise escalate.

Jamal K: good plan. if we end up evacuating node-3, update the routing policy to exclude it: `rwctl route set --exclude node-3` and bump reserved capacity.

oncall-bot: Page routed to primary (Jamal K) and secondary (Sophia L) at 1777777850 for alert `model-502-spike-prod`.

Sophia L: taking it - i'm on the page now. pinging infra to check node. @infra-team pls advise.

Alex R: infra responding, looks like transient OOM on node-3 GC. they are restarting the runtime process now.

Maria P: restart didn't fully clear KV cache; i'm doing a cache warm and will coordinate rollback if needed.

Jamal K: thanks all. i will update the shift log and handoff notes at end of shift. leaving a quick snippet in the runbook about excluding node-3 until root cause fixed.

Sophia L: confirmed coverage. primary: Jamal K -> will hand back at 01:00 UTC. secondary: Sophia L. shadow: Maria P until 21:30 UTC. everyone ok with that?

Alex R: yep. :ok_hand:

Maria P: all set. I'll stay reachable during my shadow window.

Jamal K: handoff thread closed after post-shift notes. leaving monitoring alerts enabled. :white_check_mark:
